<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_3DPrint" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/3dprint-custom-model">

  <bpmn:message id="Message_Sketches" name="Sketches"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ChangeRequest" name="Change request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProjectSTL" name="Artist result (STL)"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_3DPrint">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Artist" name="Artist"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Sketches" name="Sketches" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Participant_Artist" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ChangeRequest" name="Change request" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Participant_Artist" messageRef="Message_ChangeRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Result" name="STL result" sourceRef="Participant_Artist" targetRef="Event_ReceiveResult" messageRef="Message_ProjectSTL"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer process" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CraveModel" name="Craving a custom 3D model"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSketches" name="Instruct artist and send sketches" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveResult" name="Artist result received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ReceiveResult" messageRef="Message_ProjectSTL"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_Satisfied" name="Satisfied with result?" default="Flow_ChangeRequest"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendChanges" name="Tell artist what to change" messageRef="Message_ChangeRequest"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseColor" name="Choose plastic color"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_InStock" name="Color in stock at home?" default="Flow_NotInStock"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckAmount" name="Check remaining amount of plastic"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_Amount" name="Less than 100 g left?" default="Flow_AmountOk"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddShoppingList" name="Add plastic to shopping list"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderPlastic" name="Order plastic"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Merge_Plastic" name="Plastic available"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Split_Prep" name="Prepare printing"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TurnOnPrinter" name="Turn on printer and heat bed and extruder (monitor status feedback)"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateGcode" name="Generate G-code from STL"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Join_Prep" name="Preparation complete"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrintModel" name="Print model"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ModelPrinted" name="Model printed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start" sourceRef="Start_CraveModel" targetRef="Task_SendSketches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SketchesSent" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Event_ReceiveResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ResultReceived" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveResult" targetRef="GW_Satisfied"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChangeRequest" name="No" sourceRef="GW_Satisfied" targetRef="Task_SendChanges"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChangesSent" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Event_ReceiveResult"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Satisfied" name="Yes" sourceRef="GW_Satisfied" targetRef="Task_ChooseColor">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${satisfied == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ColorChosen" sourceRef="Task_ChooseColor" targetRef="GW_InStock"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InStock" name="Yes" sourceRef="GW_InStock" targetRef="Task_CheckAmount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${inStock == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInStock" name="No" sourceRef="GW_InStock" targetRef="Task_OrderPlastic"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AmountChecked" sourceRef="Task_CheckAmount" targetRef="GW_Amount"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Below100g" name="Yes" sourceRef="GW_Amount" targetRef="Task_AddShoppingList">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${amountBelow100g == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AmountOk" name="No" sourceRef="GW_Amount" targetRef="Merge_Plastic"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShoppingListAdded" sourceRef="Task_AddShoppingList" targetRef="Merge_Plastic"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ordered" sourceRef="Task_OrderPlastic" targetRef="Merge_Plastic"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlasticReady" sourceRef="Merge_Plastic" targetRef="Split_Prep"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TurnOn" sourceRef="Split_Prep" targetRef="Task_TurnOnPrinter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Generate" sourceRef="Split_Prep" targetRef="Task_GenerateGcode"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrinterReady" sourceRef="Task_TurnOnPrinter" targetRef="Join_Prep"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GcodeReady" sourceRef="Task_GenerateGcode" targetRef="Join_Prep"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Print" sourceRef="Join_Prep" targetRef="Task_PrintModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Printed" sourceRef="Task_PrintModel" targetRef="End_ModelPrinted"/>

  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>
